speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. To begin our assessment of your double vision, climbing difficulty, and upper limb weakness, please tell me: how long have these symptoms been present, and did they start suddenly or gradually?

speaker: Patient
text: The double vision usually happens when I look up or down, and the weakness in my arms and legs gets worse after activity but improves if I rest. I have not noticed balance problems or numbness.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Myasthenia Gravis

The pattern of worsening weakness with activity that improves with rest, along with double vision upon looking up or down, is highly characteristic of myasthenia gravis. I am ready to confirm this with specific testing if needed.
